verdict.rationale: Snyk documents explicit bulk operations: the API/CLI supports running operations on targets, scans, and findings 'one by one or in bulk by providing identifiers or applying a filter' (snyk-docs-71), CLI flags like --all-projects/--yarn-workspaces for testing many projects at once (snyk-docs-43), and /snyk-batch-fix for addressing multiple vulnerabilities at once in agentic workflows (snyk-docs-23). This shows genuine bulk-operation support across CLI, API, and agentic/AI-native fix flows. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of bulk API usage at scale, no detail on bulk operation limits or performance, and no evidence of bulk operations for other item types (e.g., bulk policy or ignore rule management).
